description: parse_int_or(default=0) (SCHEMA.md §4): lww text -> int when it matches ^[+-]?\d+$ and fits i64; otherwise the default. Covers leading sign, leading zeros, whitespace rejection, and every degenerate class (non-numeric, empty, fractional, null). The two out-of-i64-range cases (one over i64::MAX, one under i64::MIN) fall to the default, pinning that Rust str::parse overflow and the JS BigInt range check agree (both land on 0, avoiding any Number-precision confound).
